rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: ConsensusClusterPlus with 1000 resamples at 80% item and feature subsampling, k 2..8, two distance/linkage settings, k chosen from CDF, delta area and PAC together, item and cluster consensus, ARI and Fisher/chi-square against condition, and clusters tabulated against library size and detected genes as confounders. It explicitly builds in the null calibration (permuted and Gaussian nulls with identical configuration, empirical p-value for PAC) and a subsample ARI/Jaccard stability check, which is exactly what separates real structure from the algorithm's default output. QC is design-specific (blind VST, PCA on top 500 genes, distance heatmap, depth correlations with PCs, flag-only outlier policy, honest note that an unmeasured batch cannot be excluded), the filterByExpr filter is minimal and stated, and normalization stays inside DESeq2. Design formula ~condition is stated only for the blind VST, and the plan correctly declines any DE contrast or FDR on clusters defined from the same matrix, so those two criteria are judged on the correctness of the omission rather than on a stated contrast or alpha; the reporting step includes sessionInfo, seeds, gene counts kept and the null-structure caveat.
